<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the base peak at m/z 235.1395 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 234.132 Da. A formula that matches this mass and the observed M+1 intensity (≈ 16 % of the base peak, indicating ~14–15 carbons) is C₁₄H₁₈O₃ (exact monoisotopic mass = 234.1256 Da, within a few ppm of the measured value). This formula also fits the isotopic pattern. 

Thus the molecular formula of the sample compound is: C14H18O3.
